summary: Implemented every stub in babel/lists.py, babel/localedata.py, babel/localtime/_win32.py, babel/messages/checkers.py (including the missing _find_checkers helper) and babel/messages/extract.py (token-based Python extractor, JavaScript extractor, template-string parser, and the extract/extract_from_file/extract_from_dir pipeline), and fixed a merge/alias-resolve bug in localedata. The last full-suite run showed 5599 passed, 1105 failed, 5 skipped; the six test files covering my modules pass except 4 JS extract tests that fail inside babel/messages/jslexer.py (comment tokens are dropped and jsx=False raises a tokenizer error), and the remaining unit failures (KeyError 'long') come from root locale data lacking long unit patterns, outside my files.
